$schema: stock-Chrome network-fingerprint references, keyed by Chrome major version
$why: Lobium's stable JA4/PeetPrint ClientHello signatures and Akamai HTTP/2 SETTINGS signature must equal the stock Chrome it forks. Raw JA3 is captured for diagnosis but not compared because Chrome randomizes extension order per connection. A shape check (t13d....h2) passes on every TLS 1.3 browser and therefore proves nothing; equality against a real stock capture catches stable cipher, ALPS, and SETTINGS drift while leaving randomized JA3 out of the verdict.
$capture: LOBSTER_STOCK_CHROME_BIN=<stock chrome of that major> node ci/validation/tls-fingerprint.mjs --capture-reference
$policy: Values here are MEASURED, never hand-written. An unpinned major BLOCKS the gate (exit 2) rather than passing it: no reference means no comparison, which is not the same as agreement. Recapture whenever the engine is rebased onto a new Chromium major.
